name: Adjudication At Law
overview: Scripture cautions believers to avoid contentious legal disputes and strife, emphasizing the wisdom of resolving conflicts quickly and privately rather than escalating them. Proverbs highlights that strife begins like a flood of water and urges ceasing contention before it worsens, advising to debate causes directly with one’s neighbor to prevent shame and infamy. Jesus, in Matthew, reinforces this by instructing to agree with adversaries promptly to avoid harsh judgment and imprisonment. Together, these verses underscore the honor and prudence found in pursuing peace and reconciliation instead of hastily entering legal adjudication.
